name: GLHF
short: Community and developer inference gateway providing free testing routes for popular open-weight models via an OpenAI-compatible API.

plans.name: Free Testing Tier
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key for your local environment (no credit card required). Designed for CLI coding tools (Aider, Cline) and developers experimenting with open weights (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek).
